title: Omafan
stale: Sensor readings expired. Manual controls are disabled until fresh data arrives.
writeFailed: Could not save fan control. Your previous saved choice is retained.
writeTimeout: The fan command timed out. Check the current control status before trying again.
heartbeatFailed: Fan control stopped responding. The safety service will attempt firmware automatic control.
unsupported: This widget requires Apple Silicon hardware running Linux.
driverMissing: The macsmc_hwmon driver is unavailable. This does not mean this Mac is fanless.
sensorNote: These sensors do not measure CPU or GPU die temperature.
setup: Monitoring only. Install or update the control service to save manual fan speeds.
leaseNote: Your saved speed is restored across shell restarts and reboots. Auto restores firmware control.
automaticNote: Your Mac adjusts cooling automatically to match its workload.
controlUnavailable: Fan controls are unavailable right now. Your saved choice is retained.
rememberedIndependent: Each fan’s speed is remembered across restarts
linkedNote: One target controls all fans. Each fan stays within its own hardware limits.
separateMemoryMismatch: The remembered separate profile does not match these fans. Linked control remains available.
separateMemoryUnsupported: Update the control service to remember separate speeds while using Linked control.
linkedMemoryUnsupported: Update the control service to remember Linked speed independently of Separate controls.
